products.name: Polyethylene Resin
products.description: A widely used thermoplastic material manufactured in Saudi Arabia for packaging and industrial applications.
products.overview: Polyethylene is a versatile polymer produced by converting ethylene into long molecular chains. Saudi petrochemical manufacturers produce several polyethylene grades used in packaging, containers, pipes, and other products.
production_steps: Prepare ethylene feedstock and processing materials.
Convert ethylene into polyethylene through polymerization.
Separate and recover the polymer.
Melt, extrude, and cut the polymer into pellets.
Test and package the finished resin.

products.name: Pharmaceutical Tablets
products.description: Solid oral medicines produced through controlled pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
products.overview: Pharmaceutical tablets are manufactured by combining active pharmaceutical ingredients with supporting materials in carefully controlled formulations. Saudi manufacturers such as SPIMACO operate facilities that produce oral solid medicines.
production_steps: Verify and measure approved ingredients.
Blend the formulation to the required specifications.
Granulate the material when required by the formulation.
Compress the prepared mixture into tablets.
Apply coating when required.
Conduct quality testing and package the tablets.

products.name: Fresh Milk
products.description: Fresh dairy milk processed and packaged in Saudi Arabian food-manufacturing facilities.
products.overview: Fresh milk production combines dairy farming with modern food processing. Almarai operates dairy farms and processing facilities in Saudi Arabia, including Al-Kharj, where milk is processed, packaged, and prepared for refrigerated distribution.
production_steps: Collect fresh milk from dairy farms.
Transport and store the milk under controlled temperatures.
Test the milk for quality and food safety.
Pasteurize and homogenize the milk as required.
Fill and seal food-grade containers.
Refrigerate the finished product for distribution.

products.name: Rolled Aluminium
products.description: Aluminium products manufactured through refining, smelting, casting, and rolling processes.
products.overview: Saudi Arabia has developed integrated aluminium production capabilities, including bauxite mining, alumina refining, aluminium smelting, and rolling. Maaden operates an aluminium production complex at Ras Al Khair that supports industrial and commercial applications.
production_steps: Mine and prepare bauxite ore.
Refine bauxite into alumina.
Smelt alumina to produce aluminium.
Cast aluminium into suitable forms.
Roll the metal to the required thickness.
Inspect and prepare the finished material.

products.name: Phosphate Fertilizer
products.description: Mineral-based fertilizer manufactured to supply phosphorus nutrients for agriculture.
products.overview: Saudi Arabia produces phosphate fertilizers by processing mineral phosphate resources into agricultural products. Maaden's phosphate operations include the production of fertilizers such as diammonium phosphate, supporting agricultural supply chains in domestic and international markets.
production_steps: Extract and prepare phosphate rock.
Process the rock to obtain phosphoric acid.
React phosphoric acid with ammonia.
Form fertilizer granules.
Dry, screen, and inspect the granules.
Store and package the fertilizer.

products.name: Electrical Distribution Boards
products.description: Electrical assemblies manufactured to distribute and protect electrical power in buildings and industrial facilities.
products.overview: Electrical distribution boards combine protective devices, electrical connections, and engineered enclosures to distribute power safely. Saudi manufacturer alfanar produces electrical distribution systems and panels through its industrial operations in Riyadh.
production_steps: Prepare the electrical design and specifications.
Fabricate and prepare the enclosure.
Install busbars and electrical components.
Assemble the internal electrical connections.
Inspect the assembly and perform electrical tests.
Label and prepare the finished board for delivery.
